Release v1.10.0b (1 May 2020) |previous_update = [[Release v1.9|Egg Hunt 2020 Update]] |next_update = [[Release v1.11|Smaller = Bigger Update]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Release v1.10''' was the twenty-second update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 29th of April 2020. This update is notable for adding [[Polluted Wasteland]] to the game. As with most updates before the [[Solar Eclipse Event]], there was no official name for updates. As a result, the name '''Release v1.10''' has been retroactively applied to this update. However, since this update brought the [[Polluted Wasteland]] map, it can also be called, '''Polluted Wasteland Update'''. This version encompassed three updates, the main Release v1.10.0 update (released 29 April 2020) and two minor updates, the Release v1.10.0a (released 29 April 2020) and Release v1.10.0b (released 1 May 2020). ==Additions== ===Enemies=== :Multiple enemies were added for [[Polluted Wasteland]] map, replacing regular enemies on that map: *[[Radioactive]] (Replaced [[Heavy]]) *[[Wasted Boss]] (Replaced [[Abnormal Boss]]) *[[Amalgamation (Polluted Wasteland)|Amalgamation]] (Replaced [[Giant Boss]]) *[[Splitter (Polluted Wasteland)|Splitter]] (Replaced [[Boomer]]) **Spawned [[Split (Polluted Wasteland)|Split]] upon death *[[Rusher (Polluted Wasteland)|Rusher]] (Replaced [[Hazard]]) *[[Circuit (Hardcore)|Circuit]] (Replaced [[Error]]) *[[Nuclear Fallen King]] (Replaced [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]]) ===Maps=== *[[Polluted Wasteland]] ===Crates=== *New skins for the [[Premium Crate]] **Skins: ***[[Minigunner]]: {{Color|Premium|Hazmat}} ***[[Electroshocker]]:
